title: Cool stuff near Wink Saigon
sub: Hipster cafés and wanders within ~1 km of Wink Hotel Saigon Centre (Đa Kao), Nov 2026
tip: Everything here is a 5–15 min walk from Wink. Đa Kao and Tân Định are the low-rise, local side of District 1. For the bigger hipster scene (Tôn Thất Đạm, Café Apartment), Grab it ~10 min south.
area: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: Wink Hotel Saigon Centre
places.addr: 75 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Đa Kao, District 1

places.name: A Coffee House
notes: Tiny specialty roaster on a quiet Đa Kao side street, ~5 min walk
One of Saigon's specialty-coffee pioneers, still roasting in-house

places.name: Jade Emperor Pagoda
notes: Free; go early morning before the tour groups

places.name: Grandmum Café
notes: Hidden down an alley, done up like grandma's old Saigon house
Near the pink church, ~12 min walk

places.name: Tân Định Church
notes: The pink church, then the low-rise lanes behind it (Time Out's 12th coolest neighbourhood, 2026)
Cà Phê Đỗ Phủ at 113A Đặng Dung has a wartime commando bunker

places.name: Tân Định Market
notes: Proper local market: fabric, street food stalls, cheap eats
Pair with the church next door
places.addr: Hai Bà Trưng × Nguyễn Hữu Cầu

places.name: Saigon Zoo & Botanical Gardens
notes: Big shady park ~7 min walk east, good for a morning stroll
The zoo part is dated; go for the trees
